source_statement_review.author: Yuta Nishibuchi
source_statement_review.title: p-adic Congruences of Generalized Euler Numbers and Relations to Even Zeta Values
source_statement_review.interpretation: Prior exact-source inspection is preserved with version and hashes. Consolidation does not claim to have reopened the original paper.

declaration_inventory.scope: Every explicitly named theorem, lemma, def or abbrev in the 14 release-frontier inventories and the earlier standalone native affine report, including contracts and positive control support. Anonymous examples, generated declarations, development attempts, negative controls and nested historical snapshots are outside the named-declaration count. Source files for release negative controls are nevertheless hash-checked.
declaration_inventory.exact_source_copy_policy: Byte-identical copies across frontiers produce one row retaining all paths.
declaration_inventory.version_policy: Different source hashes remain distinct even if names match; source_version_count_for_name marks these. They must not be summed as unique mathematical theorems.
